img16 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0016.png')

ys16, xs16 = np.where(mask16_p2 > 0)
u16 = np.mean(xs16)
print(f"Frame 16 plant 2 center: u={u16:.1f}, y={np.mean(ys16):.1f}")

x6, y6, th6 = get_bearing(6, u6)
x16, y16, th16 = get_bearing(16, u16)
